**Last Updated:** `r format(Sys.Date(), "%B %d, %Y")`

This document provides an up-to-date listing of metadata files stored in `docs/metadata/`, used for covariate processing and QA in the regional skew modeling workflow.

## Table of Contents

- [Metadata Inventory](#metadata-inventory)
  - [Metadata Files in docs/metadata](#metadata-files-in-docsmetadata)

## Metadata Files in docs/metadata

```{r metadata-inventory_1, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(fs)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(knitr)


# 1. List metadata files, including subdirectories (e.g. data-dictionaries/)
metadata_files <- dir_info(here("docs", "metadata"), recurse = TRUE) %>%
  filter(type == "file") %>%
  mutate(
    file_name = path_file(path),
    ext = path_ext(path),
#    folder = path_rel(path_dir(path), start = here("docs")),  # Show subfolder
folder = path_rel(path_dir(path), start = here("docs", "metadata")),
folder = if_else(folder == ".", 
                 "metadata", 
                 path_file(folder)
                 ),
    size_kb = round(size / 1024, 1),
    size_display = if_else(size < 1024, "<1 KB", paste0(size_kb, " KB"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(folder, file_name) %>%
  select(folder, file_name, ext, size_display)

# 2. Render the table
metadata_files %>%
  rename(
    `File Name` = file_name,
    `Extension` = ext,
    `Size` = size_display
  ) %>%
  kable(align = "lcc")




```
